School of Evocation.description: Focuses on manipulating energy to create explosions of fire, crackling lightning, and brilliant force.

2.name: Evocation Savant
2.tldr: The gold and time you must spend to copy an evocation spell into your spellbook is halved.

2.name: Sculpt Spells
2.tldr: Create pockets of safety in your evocation area-of-effect spells so your allies take no damage.

6.name: Potent Cantrip
6.tldr: Targets take half damage even if they succeed on their saving throw against your wizard cantrips.

10.name: Empowered Evocation
10.tldr: Add your Intelligence modifier to one damage roll of any wizard evocation spell you cast.

14.name: Overchannel
14.tldr: Maximize the damage of a 1st- through 5th-level wizard spell at the cost of taking necrotic feedback damage.

School of Abjuration.description: Focuses on magical wards, protective barriers, and the negation of hostile spells.

2.name: Abjuration Savant
2.tldr: The gold and time you must spend to copy an abjuration spell into your spellbook is halved.

2.name: Arcane Ward
2.tldr: Weave a magical ward around yourself that absorbs damage, recharging whenever you cast abjuration spells.

6.name: Projected Ward
6.tldr: Interpose your Arcane Ward to protect an ally within 30 feet from taking damage.

10.name: Improved Abjuration
10.tldr: Add your proficiency bonus to any ability check you make when casting Counterspell or Dispel Magic.

14.name: Spell Resistance
14.tldr: Gain advantage on saving throws against spells, and resistance to damage dealt by spells.
